title: No AI After Auschwitz? Bridging AI and Memory Ethics in the Context of Information Retrieval of Genocide-Related Information
reasoning: The paper specifically analyzes the intersection of 'memory ethics' and AI-driven information retrieval, applying the Belmont criteria (respect for individuals, beneficence, and justice) to evaluate the ethical implications of curating genocide-related information. Ethics is the primary focus of the discussion, not a peripheral section.
